question: India's first biofuel-powered flight landed at IGI Airport in New Delhi from ______ in 2018.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dehradun**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In August 2018, India's first biofuel flight **took off from **Dehradun (the capital of Uttarakhand)** and landed at **Indira Gandhi International Airport in Delhi**.
 
• **SpiceJet's turboprop Q-400 **plane took part in the world's first biofuel test flight.
 
• These test flights have already taken place in developed countries such as Canada, Australia, and the United States.
 
• India was the** first country **in the developing world to do a biofuel test flight.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The main international airport servicing **Delhi **is **Indira Gandhi International Airport**.
 
• The airport is located in Palam, Delhi, 15 kilometres south of the New Delhi Railway Station and 16 kilometres from the city centre.
 
• It is stretched out on 5,106 acres. Since 2009, it has been India's busiest airport in terms of passenger volume, having been named after former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi.
 
• In terms of freight traffic, it has surpassed Mumbai since late 2015.
 
• Before its management was passed to the Airports Authority of India, the airport was operated by the Indian Air Force.
